Application to amend zoning for 170 to 200 Northfield Drive W and 570 to 655 Weber Street North
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus City Council before anything can be built.
Northfield Equities Inc. is proposing to develop a high-density residential community with commercial and employment uses on the subject lands. The plan includes
11 high-rise towers, five 1-storey buildings for employment/commercial uses and two park spaces, totaling 1.06 hectares.
Official plan changes requested include:
re-designating a portion of the lands from Employment to Station Area Mixed-Use designation
creating a new Specific Provision Area (SPA) to permit the following:
36 storey maximum building height for three buildings
32 storey maximum building height for two buildings; and
Permit logistics distribution, wholesale uses, small-scale warehousing as primary uses.
Existing and planned commercial uses shall not
exceed 8,500 square metres of building floor area, and new commercial uses shall not exceed 3,716 sq.m. of building floor area.
Zoning By-law changes requested include:
Station Area Mixed-Use -105 (SAMU-105) Zone
change in zoning, on a portion of the lands, from the Business Employment Two B (E2B-81) Zone to:
(Holding) Station Area Mixed-Use ((H)SAMU) Zone for the southerly portion of the subject lands.
recognize existing commercial uses as contributing towards the minimum non-residential area building floor area per dwelling unit requirement.
permit Assisted Living Facility and Long-Term Care Facility as primary uses
allowing a maximum density of 1,300 bedrooms per hectare across SAMU zoned lands
increase the tower height to 36 storeys (115 m)
tower separation shall not apply to an interior lot line provided a minimum 22 m separation is maintained between towers.
increasing the maximum horizontal tower dimension to 42 m for one building
reducing the tower separation to 5 m and 3m for one tower abutting the existing public trail.
reducing the tower stepback above the podium to 2 m for a maximum of three towers.
permit structured parking on the first storey provided a minimum of 20% is comprised of specified uses.
permit parks and open space uses in the SAMU-105 Zone.
Station Area Business Employment Two B -81 (E2B-81) Zone
permit existing and established commercial uses on the Lands.
permit a maximum of 8,500 sq.m of commercial uses on a portion of the lands.
permit logistics distribution, wholesale uses, small-scale warehousing as primary uses
limiting ancillary commercial uses to a maximum 40% of building floor area, and combined building area of 3,716 square m for specific buildings
permit complementary and ancillary uses to be located on the first storey of a building and exempt from locating on the street line building façade.
increase the maximum building height to 30 storeys
Other Regulations
In the event of any future subdivision, the following are exempted provided the balance of the lands are zoning compliance: lot frontage, landscaped open space, landscape buffer, non-residential uses, and common outdoor amenity area.
exempting the split zone regulations
removing the Holding symbol as it relates to adjacent of the railway
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: 36 storeys
Number of units: 3,084
Unit sizes: mix of one, two and three bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Non-residential floor space
Employment: 22,239 sq.m.
Commercial space: 342 sq.m.
Parking
Parking: 2,467 (primarily underground with 403 surface spaces)
Bicycle parking: 2,205
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.

Do not include personal or identifying information in your question; if your question is of a personal nature, consider contacting a member of the project team directly. For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
Questions will be answered by a member of the Planning department within two business days. Some questions may require more time but they will be answered as soon as the information for the response can be collected.
